name: phonehome
description: PhoneHome — the home phone, reborn. Private family softphones. Maintained by trevlars.

scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w gateway && npm run build -w control
scripts.lab: npm run build -w web && npm run start -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web && npm run test -w gateway && npm run test -w control && node --test deploy/duckdns.test.mjs
scripts.screenshots: npm run build -w web && node scripts/capture-readme-screenshots.mjs && node scripts/generate-app-store-screenshots.mjs
